_about: Synthetic Uninstall-tab data written by the real build code (python -m tests.make_uninstall_fixture). dashboard_uninstall = dashboard.json's "uninstall" key; asset = site/uninstall.json.gz; cohort_files = site/uninstall_c_<key>.json.gz; sent = what each of the 7 daily runs would notify (dry run); public_log = the build-log lines. Made-up apps only.
